summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q2 2026 production of 1,943,955 oz silver and 10,474 oz gold, totaling 3.4 million silver equivalent oz. The release discusses operational updates across three mines: Terronera plant optimization, Kolpa expansion increasing throughput 19% quarter-over-quarter, and Guanaceví stable throughput. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine quarterly production report filed as a foreign private issuer Form 6-K.
